result.summary: Do not ship: HTTP error logging exposes configured credentials in stderr and the web log buffer.

findings.title: Raw HTTP exceptions leak URL credentials
findings.body: A supported configuration such as http://alice:proxy-password@radarr:7878 exposes its password when connection validation receives a 502. Reproduced with MockTransport: formatting HTTPStatusError prints the complete URL into both stderr and the web log buffer. collect_secrets() in startup.py collects API keys and auth secrets, but excludes URL credentials, so the existing redaction sinks do not protect this path. Previously this branch logged only the status code.
findings.recommendation: Restore status-code-only logging, or explicitly remove URL userinfo and sensitive URL components before logging. Add a regression test verifying that a credential-bearing URL cannot expose its password in either sink.

next_steps: Fix the credential disclosure and verify both log sinks before merging.
